svg.aria-label: a never-emitted click contributes to neither count
svg.text: The accounting — on time, after a retraction, or never
1 + 2 + 2 = 5 · the retracted result is a NO-MATCH
2 // Two of a row's five columns are CLOCKS, which ch01 established:
3 // et = event time, when it happened · pt = processing time, when we saw it
4 // key = which stream it is on: "a" = clicks, "b" = impressions
5 type Row { id, key, et, pt, v }
6 // primitive: EVENTS — the book's 9 rows, in ARRIVAL order (tools/stream_seed.js).
7 // EVENTS[7] = (id 7, key "b", et 50, pt 280, v 4) <- the late impression
8 // primitive: NONE — no value. Distinct from a value of 0.
9 // primitive: J — the join window, in seconds. J = 60
10 // primitive: LAG — each side's assumed worst-case skew. LAG = 60
11 // primitive: KEYS — the two sides. KEYS = ["a", "b"]
12 // primitive: LEFT / RIGHT — the side names. LEFT = "a" · RIGHT = "b"
13 // primitive: rowsOf(key) — one side of the join.
15 // primitive: absDiff(a, b) — the distance between two times. absDiff(1, 50) = 49
16 // primitive: append(xs, x) — xs with x added at the end. append([1], 2) = [1,2]
17 // primitive: indexOf(r) — r's position in ARRIVAL order. indexOf(EVENTS[7]) = 7
22 // primitive: joinWatermark(i) — the minimum over both inputs after row i.
24 // primitive: trueMatches() — every pair within J, independent of any pipeline.
26 // primitive: matchesOf(clickId) — that click's impressions, from trueMatches().
29 // primitive: rowById(id) — the row with that id.
31 // primitive: contains(xs, x) — is x in xs? contains([1,2], 2) = true
33 // function: emitFor(l) — what the join publishes for this click, and when. A click
34 // with no match YET still publishes: a NO-MATCH is a result.
41 if (when == NONE && w != NONE && w > l.et + J) { when = i }
52 // function: contradictedBy(l) — impressions that match this click but arrive AFTER
53 // its emission, so the published result has to be withdrawn.
59 if (contains(e.matched, m) == false) { out = append(out, m) }
65 // function: tally() — all matches, by what actually happens to them.
80 // function: main() — THE CALLER: one retraction case, and the whole tally.
Step 3/0 — a never-emitted click contributes to neither count
Click 4 needs the join watermark above 305 and it reaches 200, so `when` stays NONE. It emits nothing at all — not a match, not a no-match. Its 2 true
matches are simply absent, which downstream is indistinguishable from a click that matched nothing.
